cues: And two boys: Hongr, the narrator's nephew, and Shuisheng, Runtu's son, the image of young Runtu without the necklet.
They become friends at once, exactly as their elders once did.
When the mother asks Runtu to call her son brother, as he used to, Runtu refuses: he was a child then and did not understand.
